rows.ARS: Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
rows.Origin: Bred by Wilfried Delforge / Select Delforge (Belgium, 1985).
rows.Bloom: Mauve or purple blend. Flowers violet-mauve with pink shadings. Moderate fragrance. Classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for cut flower or garden.
